title: Complement of rank-one consistency probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$. The probability that, for independent uniform $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the product of the dot products $\langle\gamma,x\rangle\langle\gamma,y\rangle$ differs from the matrix pairing $\sum_{i,j}A_{ij}x_i y_j$ is $1$ minus the probability that these two quantities are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb F_2$
